fields.works: Govinda-vijaya; Kṛṣṇa-maṅgala; Pāṭa-paryaṭana (a summary of the Pāṭa-nirṇaya); Abhirāma Ṭhākurera Śākhā-nirṇaya
fields.notes: Named as author of the Govinda-vijaya and Kṛṣṇa-maṅgala (Baṅgīya Sāhitya Sevaka) and of the Pāṭa-paryaṭana and Abhirāma Ṭhākurera Śākhā-nirṇaya («remembering the lotus feet of Śrī Ratneśvara»); perhaps two persons. Not Abhirāma Ṭhākura (Abhirāma Gosvāmī).

A Vrajavāsī brāhmaṇa loved by the Vaiṣṇavas, living near Sanātana Gosvāmī; his mother served Rūpa and Sanātana (once the Lord, as Kānāi, gave Sanātana bhikṣā at her door). Embraced Śrīnivāsa in tears when he left with the books (Bhakti-ratnākara 3.373, 386-387); after Rūpa and Sanātana's passing resolved to give up his life.

fields.aka: Atibaḍī Jagannātha dāsa, Ativadi Jagannātha Dāsa
fields.appearance: Bhādra śukla aṣṭamī, at Kapileśvara (Purī district) (the record's text)
fields.disappearance: At the age of sixty (the record's text)
fields.works: Oṛiyā Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam (navākṣara metre); Brahmāṇḍa-bhūgola, Prema-sādhana and Dūtibodha (ascribed)
fields.notes: A brāhmaṇa of Kapileśvara, son of Bhagavān Paṇḍā and Pārvatī-devī; translated the Bhāgavatam into Oṛiyā. Lord Caitanya, displeased by remarks against bhakti-tattva in it, rebuked him, and he was called «Atibaḍī» (his followers: the Atibaḍī sampradāya). Died at sixty. Not #552.
